title: 17658 - 17658/P1250
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
stepByStepSolution: Verify fuel level and add fuel as necessary
If the fuel gauge does not reflect the true fuel level, Kontrol edin: and repair fuel level sender(s)
technicalNotes: On some vehicles, this fault may persist even after fuel is added. A test drive of 16 km / 10 mi may be required in order to clear the fault. Ref: Volkswagen CTT 20-16-02, also Ross-Tech case study.
